GEOEXCEL

From growing rice, sugarcane, sesame, to a single cement and steel dealership, today, the GeoExcel Group has multiple verticals spanning agriculture, automotive, construction and trading.

desktop.title: About | GeoExcel

headings.text: Agriculture Started our journey as farmers engaged in growing and harvesting of rice, sugarcane and sesame.
Cement & Steel Dealers Diversification into the cement & steel business. This provided us with a strong foundation to commence civil contracting services.

Civil Construction Activities In 1993 we forayed into turn-key civil construction services for the residential sector in Bangalore, India. By 2014 we expanded into commercial, industrial and infrastructure civil construction with a small mix of our own developments under the name "Anuadi Constructions"
Sustainable Development Goals & CSR focus on achieving the "United Nations 17 Sustainability Goals" and a passion driven approach to CSR activities.
Birth of "GEO EXCEL" We engage in the export trade of the products listed on our website.

SERVICES

Our team of experts facilitates the movement of goods between different countries and markets through import and export. We specialize in the transportation and trade of various types of products and goods. We specialize in providing solutions for effective supply chain management.

PROJECTS

We have successfully completed various projects in the import and export of food grains. Our projects include production, procuring, packing, distribution of Agri products, IQF Fruits & Vegetables, Canned Fruits & Vegetables, Flavours & Armoas, Pluses & Lentils, Cereals & Grains, Whole and Powdered Spices, Edible Oils and Ghee.

CERTIFICATES

Our clients include food grain traders, food processing companies, and government agencies. We have successfully assisted our clients in importing and exporting food grains across the world.

SUSTAINABILITY
Our Approach

 

Uplifting Livelihood and ensuring good work condition

Implementing Living wages for all stakeholders

Climate change

Building environment sustainable business 

 

Principles we follow

​

We follow sustainable agricultural methods of collection of natural raw materials.

We source natural raw material using proper harvesting methods, Sourced at the right time for the right price.

We support in the preservation of endangered plant species and avoid use of them. 

We practise the organic farming process and avoid the use of pesticides and chemicals.

We avoid raw materials that may effect the climate conditions.
